header.method: Every in-scope card carrying an imperative override is read against its printed text (Milestone1_Bullet7_Prompts.md, phase R). Cards with no imperative override are recorded as `not-reviewed` with their ranking score, per phase R section 4.
rankingInputs: 1. imperative surface, tiered: bespokeCanPlay/canPlay > bespokePlay/play > canAct/action/actionEssence/initialAction > event hooks > canPayWith/getCardDiscount/getAvailableSpaces > getVictoryPoints
2. coverage class from card_test_coverage.json (uncovered +20, behavioural +12, direct-but-self-spec-not-executed +6)
3. play frequency from card_play_coverage.json (log-scaled rarity bonus, 0 plays = +10)
4. the two pre-located Engine issue markers (+15): Virus.ts:36, EccentricSponsor.ts:24

verdicts.matches: implementation, metadata and printed card agree
verdicts.cosmetic-divergence: wording/rendering differs; no effect on legality, resources or scoring
verdicts.behavioural-divergence: implementation differs from the printed card in a way that changes legality, resources or scoring - an Engine defect (K5 escalation)
verdicts.undecided: correct behaviour depends on a rules interpretation not settled by the printed text; an open question for the register
verdicts.not-reviewed: not read in this pass; ranking score records where it sat in the queue

queue.rationale: legality-deciding overrides (bespokeCanPlay / canPlay); read first per K5
descending rank over the remaining imperative surface
